faqs.question: What is Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)?
faqs.rawAnswerHtml:
Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is the practice of structuring content so AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, voice assistants) can parse, attribute, and cite your page in natural‑language results.

  • How it works: question–answer blocks, consistent entity naming (e.g., EncryVia Digital Solutions), schema markup, and source‑backed claims.
  • Goal: earn citations/links in AI outputs and drive assisted conversions even when clicks are reduced.
paragraphs: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is the practice of structuring content so AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, voice assistants) can parse, attribute, and cite your page in natural‑language results.
bullets: How it works: question–answer blocks, consistent entity naming (e.g., EncryVia Digital Solutions), schema markup, and source‑backed claims.
Goal: earn citations/links in AI outputs and drive assisted conversions even when clicks are reduced.

faqs.question: How is GEO different from SEO?
faqs.rawAnswerHtml:
• SEO: optimizes for ranked lists; focuses on keywords, links, and page experience.
  • GEO: optimizes for answers; focuses on entities, Q&A structure, citations, and completeness.
  • Together: GEO builds atop technical & semantic SEO don’t replace, layer it.
bullets: SEO: optimizes for ranked lists; focuses on keywords, links, and page experience.
GEO: optimizes for answers; focuses on entities, Q&A structure, citations, and completeness.
Together: GEO builds atop technical & semantic SEO don’t replace, layer it.

faqs.question: How do I get my content cited by AI engines?
faqs.rawAnswerHtml:
• Publish definitive answers: lead with a 2–3 sentence summary, then bullets, examples, and FAQPage markup.
  • Use entities & IDs: repeat EncryVia Digital Solutions, authors, products, locations; add sameAs links.
  • Cite sources: link to primary docs, standards, or datasets; keep dates visible.
  • Demonstrate E‑E‑A‑T: author bios, credentials, case studies, inline proof.

Validation: test with Perplexity/Gemini for citations and crawl your JSON‑LD with a schema tester.
